game.title: Battlefield 1
game.blurb: First World War first-person shooter from EA DICE, published by Electronic Arts, released 2016-10-21. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the War Stories named in the Steam achievements, plus campaign extras, multiplayer and the expansions named in the achievements.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1238840)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Battlefield_1
Fandom (battlefield.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://battlefield.fandom.com/wiki/Battlefield_1
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1238840 ("Battlefield™ 1") was the only match. StrategyWiki has "Battlefield 1" as a stub (completion stage 0); only a short Table of Contents subpage exists, and its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls are linked but not written. battlefield.fandom.com answers the API under "Battlefield 1" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. Five War Stories are named in the achievement descriptions, each with a completion and an all-Codex achievement, so each has its own small chapter; "Young Men's Work" is named once without saying which War Story it belongs to, so it sits in the campaign extras. Only five achievements name an expansion (three for "In the Name of the Tsar", one each for "Turning Tides" and "Apocalypse"); RAWG lists those three as separate entries. Achievements 32 to 50 look like later additions (Elite Classes, the Gallipoli Operation, the L-Class Destroyer, the Airship L30, Supply Drop and others), but the data does not say which expansion each belongs to, so they stay in the multiplayer chapter.
